beats.event: Hester stands on the Boston scaffold wearing the scarlet A, refusing to name the father
In the crowd she spots her long-lost husband, disguised as Roger Chillingworth
Chillingworth vows privately to discover and punish her lover
Released from prison; settles in a cottage on the town's edge with baby Pearl
Earns a meagre living by her fine needlework in social exile
Wild little Pearl grows up shunned by the town's children
Hester pleads with the governor; Rev Dimmesdale intervenes and she keeps Pearl
Chillingworth lodges with the ailing Dimmesdale as his physician
Chillingworth glimpses a mark on Dimmesdale's chest; his revenge sharpens
Dimmesdale climbs the scaffold alone at midnight but cannot yet confess
In the forest Hester reveals her husband's identity and plans escape by ship
Dimmesdale, revived by hope, delivers a powerful Election Day sermon
He mounts the scaffold, confesses his sin, and dies in Hester's arms
Deprived of his victim, Chillingworth withers and dies within the year
Hester leaves for Europe with Pearl, who inherits Chillingworth's estate
Years later Hester returns alone, resumes the scarlet A as a badge of counsel
